_comment: Receipt line -> inventory_item mappings for the receipt import (ReceiptImportRunner). Keys are receipt KEYS as the import report prints them: ALL-CAPS words in normal case, PENNY abbreviations expanded (gem. -> gemischt, Hä. -> Hähnchen, Konfit -> Konfitüre, Tom -> Tomaten), then Normalizer.key (lowercase, umlauts ae/oe/ue/ss, punctuation to spaces). A key is tried for the full name, then for the name without a known brand prefix. Values are inventory_item_id; 0 = excluded on purpose. 'review' lists keys waiting for Nate's decision: they stay unmatched (NULL item) and the name rules are not asked for them. Separate from store_overrides.json on purpose: receipt names are not offer names.
